$comment: Generated from story-package.fields.json. Field guidance for the task checklist, rendered by the viewer and read by agents one field at a time. Resolve relative reference URLs from this file. Data rules live in checklist.schema.json.

task.label: Task
task.help: Name one build or setup action a single executor can finish. The story describes the repeatable operation it supports.
task.example: Run baseline extraction on the pilot PDF.
task.handoff: Send only this task, the outputs and evidence of its Requires tasks, its inputs, expected output, Task AC and guardrails. Cite supported checks or scenarios by ID.

status.label: Status
status.ai: Suggest a fixed status from the evidence. Explain exceptions in Comments.
status.review: Use Pass only when the Task AC is met and evidence is recorded.

comments.label: Comments
comments.help: Record what happened, what failed, and the next step. If stopping, explain why and link the follow-up.
comments.example: Retest returned unrelated policy text. Recheck in S-07; refine in S-08 if the error persists.

ownerType.label: Owner type
ownerType.ai: Use Automation for test runs, AI for drafting or review, and Human for acceptance. Split tasks when the executor changes.
ownerType.review: Confirm who runs the check, who reviews the evidence, and who can accept the result.

uiQa.label: UI QA?
uiQa.help: Yes when a browser journey, layout, or interaction needs checking. Record the actual result in Result evidence.
checklist: Open the affected screen as the intended user.
Check the main path and a meaningful failure case.
Record the browser, build, and result.

mobileQa.label: Mobile QA?
mobileQa.help: Yes when a mobile layout, native interaction, or device capability needs checking. Record the actual result in Result evidence.
checklist: Use the intended device or emulator, app build, and user role.
Check the main path and a mobile-specific interaction.
Use a real device if required hardware behavior is unproven.
Record the device or emulator, OS, build, and observed result.

value.label: Value
value.help: Say who benefits and what improves, such as accuracy, speed, or decision quality.
value.example: Reviewers avoid treating unrelated policy as the bid’s payment terms.

reusableArtifact.label: Reusable artifact
reusableArtifact.help: Describe the reusable template or script and record whether preparing it is planned.

example.description: Extraction workbook with a synthetic sample.

githubFile.label: Published GitHub file
githubFile.help: Link the exact published file. Show the full URL when the artifact is planned and the task reaches Pass.

requires.label: Requires
requires.help: List direct prerequisite task IDs. Each must reach Pass before starting. Omit when there are none.
requires.ai: Skip IDs already required by another listed task. Read the required outputs and evidence.

inputs.label: Expected inputs
inputs.help: List the artifacts and access needed to start. Put prerequisite tasks in Requires.
inputs.example: Pilot PDF, baseline JSON, and test processor version.

outputs.label: Expected outputs
outputs.help: Name the deliverable and format. If it uses a published template, link the exact GitHub template file here.
outputs.example: Raw extraction JSON and a Markdown comparison table. Link the published table template if one exists.

metric.label: Success metric
metric.help: Optional. Name what to maximize or minimize, how to measure it, and the guardrail. Mark untested targets Proposed.
metric.example: Minimize time to find the bucket owner. Proposed: two minutes, with correct ownership.

completion.label: Task AC
completion.help: Define how to verify this task’s output before running. Include a meaningful failure case when relevant. Close only when the check passes.
completion.example: A valid draft survives reload. An over-limit Value fails and leaves the saved JSON intact.

supports.label: Supports checks or scenarios
supports.help: IDs of story criteria, checks or scenarios this task supports. Omit when none.
supports.ai: Read only the cited criteria, checks or scenarios needed for this task.
supports.review: Use the story for inline check results and private run records for structured scenarios.

evidence.label: Result evidence
evidence.help: Files or records that show what actually happened. Put blockers and next steps in Comments.
evidence.ai: Link the actual run or review. Record revision, tool and observed result. For AI review, record model and reasoning if known.
evidence.review: Check the artifact proves the named test or review ran on the stated revision and surface.
evidence.example: Link the Playwright run or trace for the tested revision. Link code review findings separately.

scope.label: Scope
scope.help: Name the documents, fields, or decisions this task covers. Say what is out of scope.
scope.example: Retest payment terms on the same PDF. Exclude general policy pages.

direction.label: Solution approach
direction.help: Name the runner, build, environment, and fixture. Link the repeatable command or manual test steps.
direction.example: Playwright on Chromium against the local preview with a synthetic checklist.

guardrails.label: Guardrails
guardrails.help: Say what code enforces, what needs evidence, what may be inferred, and how to handle uncertainty. If retrying, set a cap and stop rule.
guardrails.example: Leave unstated payment terms blank. Stop after two retests or when there’s no new fix to test.

docs.label: Documentation and debugging
docs.help: Link the exact guide section, skill, or repo file for this action.
docs.example: Google Document AI → Send a processing request → Batch processing.

model.label: Model
model.help: For an AI task, specify the model before dispatch. For deterministic runs, name the runner in Solution approach.

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.help: Required when an AI task needs a specific reasoning setting. Use the tool's supported label.

agent.label: Agent
agent.help: Before dispatch, confirm the executor. For a roster-based story, use the agent's stable roster ID. Leave blank during planning if unassigned.

stepId.label: Step ID
stepId.help: Give each new task a stable C- ID, such as C-01. Keep existing task IDs.

statusGuide.In design: The approach or scope still needs a decision.
statusGuide.Open: Designed and waiting to start. Check prerequisites before starting.
statusGuide.In progress: Work has started; the Task AC has not been verified.
statusGuide.Pass: The task met its Task AC and has evidence.
statusGuide.Blocked: A specific dependency or pending decision prevents progress. Record it in Comments.

modelGuidance: GPT-6.2 Astra or Claude Opus 5.5, as appropriate. Final code review follows review.md.
Claude Haiku prepares evidence. Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 handles difficult unresolved bugs.
TypeSafe Jev when explicit criteria and uncertainty handling are available.
displayContract: Proposed. Render columns and details in listed order; hide visible:false fields; never edit editable:false fields.
Read types, enums, required fields and limits from checklist.schema.json; show word counters from x-maxWords and the task total from x-taskWordLimit.
Run schema validation and x-applicationChecks on load and before save; block an invalid save and show the field or APP ID.
Omit blank optional fields instead of saving empty strings; show emptyText where defined.
Render requires and supports IDs as links. Show an Open task with an unclosed requires task as Waiting on its IDs without changing status.
Link supports to the criterion, check or scenario. Render task status, scenario results and story acceptance independently.
Show help and review text to people; show ai text on request.
